ui.lede: Sign in or paste a key from each card. No long setup.
ui.open_google_title: If the browser did not open or you closed it
ui.google_approve_toast: Approve in Google — paste the code here
ui.sign_in_failed_retry: Sign-in failed — try a new code
ui.track_cursor_title: Read quota from the Cursor session on this PC — no browser sign-in
ui.refresh_cursor_title: After signing in to Cursor, reload quota
ui.untrack_account_title: Remove this account from the quota list
ui.add_account_hint: Adds an account to the quota list only. Does not switch agy’s active session.
ui.untrack_provider_title: Remove from quota list (does not sign out)
ui.empty_hint: Use Track or Sign in / Save to get started
ui.settings_bind_hint: Restart the process to change bind address or port.
ui.antigravity_stale: Last reading {time}. Not the current quota. The next Antigravity turn on this account refreshes it.
ui.antigravity_stale_reset: Last reading {time} is out of date: its reset time has passed. The next Antigravity turn on this account reads it again.

cursor.summary: Cursor desktop session on this PC (no browser sign-in).
steps: Sign in to the Cursor desktop app.
Track — quota is read from this machine’s session.
Connect with Google — approve in the browser.
Create a key on the Keys page.

t3.summary: Accounts already signed in to T3 Code on this PC.
steps: Leave T3 Code open so it keeps refreshing quotas.
Track — this card reads T3’s local cache.

errors.antigravity.no_saved_token: No saved token; sign in again.
errors.antigravity.agy_missing: Antigravity CLI (agy) not found. Install from https://antigravity.google.
errors.antigravity.closed_without_url: agy exited without a Google link.
errors.antigravity.url_timeout: agy did not return a Google sign-in link (timeout).
errors.antigravity.session_closed: Sign-in session closed. Start sign-in again.
errors.antigravity.code_timeout: timeout while agy processed the code. Get a new code and try again.
errors.antigravity.exit_failed: agy sign-in failed (exit {code}). Start sign-in again for a fresh code.
errors.antigravity.no_wincred: agy finished but there is no WinCred session. Refresh or sign in again.
